title: Eternal Sky Orbs
description: a mod that lets you control the sky
body:
✨ Eternal Sky Orbs ✨

Have you ever wanted to control the sky in Minecraft? Now you can—with the **Eternal Sky Orbs** mod!  

This mod introduces powerful new items that let you bend time itself. With the **Empty Orb**, you can capture the light of the sun or the glow of the moon and transform it into something greater. After charging for just 10 seconds, the Empty Orb becomes either a **Sun Orb** or a **Moon Orb**, giving you the ability to switch between day and night instantly, complete with smooth and magical animations.  

Changing the time has never felt this immersive. Want endless sunlight to keep building, farming, or exploring? The Sun Orb has you covered. Prefer a peaceful night for adventuring, battling mobs, or just enjoying the stars? The Moon Orb is your answer.  

No sky limit is needed—just right-click and let the heavens respond to your call. With **Eternal Sky Orbs**, the sky itself is yours to command, adding a whole new layer of wonder and control to your Minecraft world.
